svg.aria-label: Past Forever hunting the loop x = x × x + c for c from 0 to 99. Each number is a coloured square: settles, ring of 2, ring of 3, ring of 6, or goes wild. Brighter red squares are liars that look calm for a while, then go wild. It zooms into the brightest liar five times: 23, 3123, 703123, 95703123, 595703123, and 860595703123, which looks calm for 15 digits before it goes wild.

g.text: calm for 3 digits, then it goes wild
calm for 6 digits, then it goes wild
calm for 8 digits, then it goes wild
calm for 10 digits, then it goes wild
calm for 11 digits, then it goes wild
calm for 15 digits, then it goes wild
every zoom finds a better liar.
